input.question: What is the medium of "The English Patient"?

documents.text: audio edition of The English Patient , narrated by Michael York , was issued by Random House in 1993 . A film version of The English Patient , directed by Anthony Minghella , was released in 1996 . It won several Academy Awards , including Best Picture , Best Director , and Best Supporting Actress for Juliette Binoche , who played the character of Hana .
